description: This file defines configuration functions for the 1995 Dodge Neon engine, including different engine setup variants and a broken/cam sensor testing option.

methods.name: setDodgeNeon1995EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the engine with the 1995 Dodge Neon default engine setup.

methods.name: setDodgeNeonNGCEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the engine with NGC engine parameters.

methods.name: setDodgeNeonNGCEngineConfigurationCrankBased
methods.description: Configures the engine for testing or broken CAM sensor with crank-based configuration.
